units.source_text: 在变种多、不起眼的小昆虫当中，特别容易觅得这种机会。

en.t: Among small, inconspicuous insects with many variations, such opportunities were especially easy to find.

units.source_text: 因此，在很长一段时间里，他眼睛一直盯着人们所讨厌的双翅目苍蝇类。

en.t: For that reason, for a long time his eyes remained fixed on the flies of the order Diptera, which people detested.

units.source_text: 确实，苍蝇的种类惊人的丰富。

en.t: Indeed, the varieties of flies were astonishingly abundant.

units.source_text: 尽管这样说，人的想法大致相同，包括日本那种叫做八匹目的珍稀种类，几乎都被收集到了。

en.t: Even so, people tended to think along much the same lines, and almost all of them had been collected, including the rare Japanese species known as Hachihikime.

units.source_text: 大概苍蝇的生活环境与人的生活环境十分相近吧。

en.t: Perhaps the living environment of flies was very close to that of human beings.
